blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — With all the witnesses and pieces of evidence presented by the prosecution — bank and tax records, financial reports, and public documents — discussions on Article II have proven that Vice President Sara Duterte is not as simple a person as she appears, Akbayan party-list Rep. Chel Diokno said on Monday. Diokno, a member of the House of Representatives’ prosecution team, said this during Duterte’s impeachment trial when asked by Senator-judge Lito Lapid as to what is the meat of the prosecution’s case for Article II.
